name: The Galata Istanbul Hotel - MGallery
positioning: Historic Galata hotel in Baltazzi Han, a former bank building with contemporary Art Deco-influenced style and a historic hammam in its garden
best_for: Travelers who want a historic building in the Galata district
Guests who want a traditional hammam experience on site

facts.text: The hotel is in the historic Galata district, where the Golden Horn meets the Bosphorus.
The hotel is on Bankalar Caddesi in Beyoglu, Istanbul.
The hotel occupies the historic Baltazzi Han building in Galata.
The hotel is housed in a historic bank building.
The hotel's style is contemporary with distinctive Art Deco influences.
The Historical Cesme Hammam is hidden within the hotel's garden.
The hotel's restaurant serves modern and creative interpretations of Turkish cuisine.
In summer the restaurant has an open-air setting with views of the Golden Horn.

highlights.text: A historic hammam, the Historical Cesme Hammam, sits hidden within the hotel's garden.
The hotel occupies Baltazzi Han, a historic bank building in Galata.
The hotel pairs a contemporary style with distinctive Art Deco influences.
The Galata district sits where the Golden Horn meets the Bosphorus.

considerations.text: The restaurant's open-air setting with Golden Horn views is offered during the summer months.
WhataHotel notes the hotel sits on a steep hillside that requires some walking uphill.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have smaller rooms, typical of converted properties.
